name: glide-v2-extension
description: AI-assisted browser automation in a Chrome side panel

scripts.test:frontier: npm run build:all && npm run test:vitest && node dist/tests/unit/run-unit-tests.js && node dist/tests/validate-extension.js && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:integration:manual: echo 'Load tests/integration/test-page.html in browser and run tests'
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:all && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:frontier-actions:run: node dist/tests/e2e/test-frontier-actions.js --case click-once && node dist/tests/e2e/test-frontier-actions.js --case find-element && node dist/tests/e2e/test-frontier-actions.js --case checkbox-frame
scripts.test:live:ollama: npm run build:all && node scripts/run-child.mjs --env=GLIDE_LIVE_TESTS=1 dist/tests/integration/test-ollama-sdk.js
scripts.test:live:e2e: npm run build:all && node scripts/run-child.mjs --env=GLIDE_LIVE_TESTS=1 --env=E2E_TIMEOUT=120000 dist/tests/e2e/test-live-model-e2e.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.dev: echo 'Run npm run build (prod) or build:dev (sourcemaps), then load dist/ in chrome://extensions'

author: Emansecio
